Wall-Hum Echo.name: Wall-Hum Echo
Wall-Hum Echo.description: The user hums a low note against a wall or across a smoky room, and the vibration travels through solid masonry and returns as an echo they feel in their jaw. It maps one room beyond a wall or through thick smoke, revealing where each person stands, hides or lies trapped. It reaches half as far as a pure floor reading, and soft insulation, thick carpets or running engines smother the return. Strain: light.
